study type: National population-based cohort study and matched case-control study
cohort: Swedish women born 1973-1993, including 273 with Marfan syndrome and 1,017,265 without
finding: Women with Marfan syndrome were more likely to be born preterm, SGA, and by cesarean section, but they did not have an increased risk of these outcomes in their own first childbirth.
mod_finding: Women with Marfan syndrome did not have an increased risk of cesarean section in their own first childbirth.
